sf.label: Stockfish 19
sf.method: Baseline: unrestricted MultiPV 3 at every position, 10M nodes, last completed iteration. Candidate comparisons (60M nodes) and deep checks (200M nodes) restrict the root moves and keep their own budgets.

notes.text: The f-pawn push attacks the g5 knight but offers 45.Rf3+; White can evacuate the knight via e4 and later take on f6. 44...Rh8 keeps rook activity against h4 and a materially larger advantage. Carlsen lost the game only after a later separate mistake at 52...Ne2+.
Stockfish 19, 16 Nov 2026 (1 thread, 200M nodes, depth 35, deep check): Rh8 +5.45, played f6 +0.84 (mover POV). The catalog alternative is better by 4.61 pawns.
